packageRules.description: OTel log signal: hold at 0.20.x. go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/bridges/otelslog is only released up to v0.19.0, which is built against otel/log v0.20.0 — advancing the log modules alone breaks the build (undefined: log.Value / log.KeyValue, see PR #190). Remove this rule once an otelslog release supports the newer API.
bun: hold below 1.3.0. v1.3.0 changed Limit/Offset and the count helpers to int64, which breaks ~100 call sites (PR #482). Lift once the int/int64 migration is done.

chromedp/cdproto: hold at chromedp 0.16.x. v0.17 moved to a generic Action[T] API (Run, Title, Location, Evaluate, ListenTarget...) and breaks checkbrowser/session.go (PR #482). cdproto is pinned to the pseudo-version chromedp 0.16 builds against.
goja: always automerge, whatever the update type (it only ships pseudo-versions)

chromedp/headless-shell: always automerge, whatever the update type. Its version IS the Chrome version (151.0.7922.109 -> 152.x), so every ~4-week Chrome release reads to renovate as a major and is held by the no-major-automerge rule above, even though nothing breaking happened (PR #263). It is pinned only in docker-compose.yml — local dev and the E2E browser, never a shipped artifact — and CI's E2E job exercises it on every PR. Must stay AFTER the major rule: renovate applies packageRules in order and the last match wins.
